pages.text:
Births: Solenne, Year of Quiet Harvest. March, stillborn, same year. Bek, Year of Three Floods.

Deaths: Oldfather Pesk, of lung-rot. Mother Veth, of the changing sickness. Solenne — she walked into the bell quarter and did not come back.

[In a shaking hand:]

I do not want to write what happened to Bek.
